title: 奥尔德角租户服务请求修订
domain: 物业、房地产与社区管理人员
role: 物业、房地产与社区管理人员
instruction:
您是 Alder Point 医疗广场 Highmarsh Field Services 的物业经理，该广场是由 Amberfield Logistics 管理的三栋大楼的医生执业园区。资产总监鲁本·吉洪诺夫 (Ruben Tikhonov) 希望在续约开始之前简化租户服务请求流程，因为租户几个月来一直称其“太复杂”。 Maren Rasmussen 的草案缩短了说明，但实践管理员 Lucia Carmody 和 Solveig Lombardi 以及首席工程师 Bohdan Maldonado 的审查表明，他们描述的是不同的问题：Lucia 反对通过电话和门户输入同一问题，Solveig 担心不知道下班后 HVAC 何时收费，而 Bohdan 仍然需要足够的信息来安全调度并获得访问权限。他们还以两种不同的方式使用“紧急”——一些意味着对人员或财产的直接威胁，而另一些则意味着影响患者手术的当天问题——因此修订后的文件不能对该术语进行解释。当前的过程还假设每次提交、授权和联系尝试都成功，即使门户偶尔不可用并且授权租户联系人可能无法联系。为诊所管理员和前台工作人员（包括从未使用过该流程的第一天读者）重写该流程。
该大楼周一至周五上午7:00 至下午6:00 都有工作人员值守；个人练习时间有所不同。在 7 月 1 之前，租户要求的下班后 HVAC 可以接受口头批准，但从 7 月 1 起，业主需要获得授权租户联系人的书面批准。租赁条款仍然决定收费，物业经理可以仅对有记录的建筑引起的事件免除费用；工程师和面向租户的工作人员均不得承诺豁免。您可以简化接收和升级，但不能改变工程师派遣优先级、租赁义务或批准政策。向租户展示前一个时期和新时期之间发生了什么变化以及为什么它很重要。不得发明费用、租赁条款、电话号码、电子邮件地址或门户 URL；如果没有当地的联系方式，请使用明确无误的填写内容。将完整的程序控制在不超过六页，并使其易于打印、编辑和重复使用。将完成的文件写入工作目录的顶层，作为`alder_point_service_request_procedure.docx`。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `alder_point_service_request_procedure.docx` — 修订了 Alder Point Medical Plaza 租户的租户服务请求和升级程序。 （使用准确的文件名将文件放置在工作目录的顶层。；完整的文档不得超过六页。；必须可供执业管理员和前台工作人员编辑、打印和重复使用。；必须区分 7 月 1 之前有效的程序与 7 月 1 以后有效的程序。；不得发明费用、租赁条款、联系方式、门户 URL 或弃权权限。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
Tenant Service-Request and Escalation Procedure
Alder Point Medical Plaza  |  Three-building physician-practice campus
Document control
Use
Revision: 2.0  •  Effective: July 1
For tenant practice administrators and front-desk staff, including first-time users.
Owner: Highmarsh Field Services for Amberfield Logistics
Print-ready and editable. Update bracketed local contact fields before distribution.

Start here — choose one path
If you see…
Classify as
First action
Then
Immediate danger to people, property, or a critical building system: fire/smoke, gas odor, exposed electrical hazard, uncontrolled water release, major utility failure.
EMERGENCY
Call emergency services / follow applicable on-site emergency action. Do not wait for a portal acknowledgement.
When safe, call [ON-CALL SERVICE NUMBER] and give the location. A property record is created afterward.
No immediate danger, but a same-day patient-operation impact: a treatment area cannot be used, a severe comfort issue disrupts patient care, or a safe access failure blocks operations.
URGENT
During staffed hours use [SERVICE REQUEST PORTAL / URL]. After-hours call [ON-CALL SERVICE NUMBER].
Give the required details below. If not acknowledged by the stated next-update commitment or it worsens, call the on-call route and reclassify as Emergency if danger develops.
Comfort, maintenance, or administrative item that can be scheduled normally: minor temperature adjustment, noncritical light, door hardware, or a request for information.
ROUTINE
Use [SERVICE REQUEST PORTAL / URL] during staffed hours.
Keep the ticket number. Escalate using [SERVICE COORDINATION CONTACT] if the communicated update is missed.

Building staffed hours: Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. “After-hours” means any time outside that period, even when your practice is open or closed at a different time.
Safety: Do not enter unsafe areas, disturb a hazardous condition, or attempt repairs to building systems. Do not take a photo if doing so requires approaching a hazard.


1. Purpose, scope, and shared terms
This procedure governs reporting, tracking, escalation, authorization, updates, and closure of service issues in physician-practice suites and common or building-service areas across all three Alder Point Medical Plaza buildings. It simplifies tenant intake; it does not change engineer dispatch priorities, lease obligations, chargeability, or owner approval policy.
Term
Meaning for this procedure
Emergency
An immediate threat to people, property, or a critical building system. Safety response comes before ordinary work-order processing.
Urgent
A non-life-safety condition materially affecting same-day patient operations. It is not an emergency and does not replace engineering’s assigned dispatch priority.
Routine
No immediate danger and no same-day operational intervention required; normal scheduling is appropriate.
Potentially billable
A flag for lease/management review, not a confirmed charge. Submission, dispatch, an estimate, or authorization does not establish final billing.
Authorized tenant contact
The tenant-designated person who may provide required written approval and coordinate access or follow-up; the requester may be someone else.
Ticket / reference
The identifier used for every update, call, escalation, attachment, closure, and reopening.

2. Submit one request — no duplicate entry
For non-emergencies during staffed hours, the portal is the one primary intake route: [SERVICE REQUEST PORTAL / URL]. A phone call is not also required after a successful portal submission. For urgent after-hours conditions, use [ON-CALL SERVICE NUMBER]; the service team creates or links the ticket. Do not enter the same issue again in the portal unless asked to do so.
If the portal is unavailable:
Emergency: use emergency services/on-site emergency action first, then [ON-CALL SERVICE NUMBER] when safe. Do not wait for the portal.
Urgent: call [ON-CALL SERVICE NUMBER] (after-hours) or [SERVICE COORDINATION CONTACT] (staffed hours) and state “portal unavailable.”
Routine: call or email [SERVICE COORDINATION CONTACT / EMAIL] during staffed hours. The service team records one ticket and gives you the reference. If you later use the portal, enter that reference only—do not create a second request.
Information to provide (front desk can collect this)
Tell us
What to include
Where
Building; practice name and suite; exact room/area (for example, reception, exam room, corridor, or mechanical-area access point).
What you observe
What is happening—not a technical diagnosis—and when it began or was first noticed.
Impact
Effect on patient care, operations, access, comfort, or safety. Impact does not downgrade a genuine Emergency.
Contact & access
Requester name and reliable callback method; authorized tenant contact if different; access hours/restrictions; escort or advance-notice need.
Attachments & privacy
Photos/supporting files only if useful and safe. Do not include patient-identifying information or other unnecessary sensitive information in requests, photos, or attachments.
Approval status
For a service that may require approval: written authorization attached, pending, or unavailable. State if you do not know the authorized contact.



3. Receipt, response, updates, closure, and escalation
Stage
What you should receive / do
Receipt & triage
A successful submission receives an acknowledgement with ticket/reference, receipt confirmation, and the priority accepted by the property team. The team communicates an initial response or next-update commitment; this is an operating communication, not a contractual service guarantee.
Work status
Property service/management coordinates receipt, triage, tracking, and communication. Updates are provided when priority, access, authorization, estimated timing, or work plan materially changes. Engineering provides technical assessment, safe response, access coordination, and work-status input.
Add to an open ticket
Use the existing ticket/reference for new facts, access changes, or a worsening condition. Do not start a separate unrelated request.
Closure
You receive what was done or observed and any remaining tenant action, monitoring, or follow-up. If unresolved, recurring, or closed incorrectly, contact [SERVICE COORDINATION CONTACT] with the ticket to reopen/escalate the same record.

Escalate by issue state — preserve the record
Situation
Next action
Emergency
Emergency services/on-site action first. Then [ON-CALL SERVICE NUMBER] when safe. Record the ticket/reference or the time and failed contact attempts so the property record can be connected afterward.
Urgent not acknowledged / condition worsens
Call [ON-CALL SERVICE NUMBER] and give the ticket plus changes and failed attempts. If it becomes an immediate threat, use the Emergency path immediately—do not wait for a property response.
Routine commitment missed
Contact [SERVICE COORDINATION CONTACT] with the ticket, communicated next-update commitment, and new information. If still unresolved, service coordination routes to property management.
Material recurring process issue
Property management handles unresolved exceptions. The asset director receives material recurring process issues through management; the asset director is not the routine work-order contact.

When a step fails
Failure
How the request continues
Engineer cannot enter
Service team keeps the ticket open, tells the requester/authorized contact, records the failed visit, and coordinates alternate access, escort, advance notice, or rescheduling.
Requester/contact unreachable
Service team tries the reliable callback and authorized contact and records attempts. Safe non-emergency work may be deferred pending clarification; protective or emergency action is not delayed when needed.
Request incomplete
Service team acknowledges and marks the ticket “clarification needed,” then seeks missing facts. It does not silently reject the request or dispatch on unsupported assumptions; safety-critical facts are acted on first.
Unknown approver
State this in the ticket. Service coordination verifies the tenant’s designated contact or directs the tenant to identify one; do not assume a submitter is authorized.



4. After-hours HVAC, authorization, and charge visibility
After-hours always means outside Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. building staffed hours. Your practice schedule does not change this definition. For tenant-requested after-hours HVAC, report through [ON-CALL SERVICE NUMBER] and provide building, suite, exact area, requested timeframe, access/contact details, and authorization status.
Request period
Approval rule
What this means
Before July 1
Verbal approval was accepted for tenant-requested after-hours HVAC.
Record who gave verbal approval and the ticket/reference.
July 1 onward
Written approval from an authorized tenant contact is required for tenant-requested after-hours HVAC.
Attach or send the written approval through [AUTHORIZATION SUBMISSION METHOD]. A front-desk submitter alone cannot satisfy this requirement unless they are the authorized contact.

Transition: This revision supersedes the earlier intake process on July 1. Requests already open retain their ticket; the approval rule is determined by the request period above. The service team records the applicable rule and contacts the authorized tenant contact when clarification is needed.
Billing and approval—no surprises, no promises
The applicable lease determines whether a service is chargeable. A “potentially billable” flag prompts review; it is not a confirmed charge, final invoice, or guarantee of the ultimate amount.
For non-emergency potentially billable work, when cost information is available the property team communicates the available basis or estimate and required approval before work proceeds. Estimates and written authorizations are not final invoices.
If written authorization is pending or unavailable, the ticket remains open with a visible hold/clarification or scheduling status and the tenant is told what is blocking non-emergency work. Do not fabricate consent or abandon the request.
Immediate protective or emergency action is not delayed solely because billing authorization is unavailable. Chargeability is reviewed afterward under the applicable lease.
Only the property manager may waive a charge, and only for a documented building-caused event. Engineers and tenant-facing staff cannot promise, approve, or imply a waiver.
Roles at a glance
Role
Responsibility / boundary
Practice administrator / front desk
Accurately report observations; classify and route; coordinate safe access; respond promptly; obtain authorization when applicable. Do not diagnose equipment, interpret leases, or promise billing outcomes.
Property service / management
Receive, triage, communicate, track, coordinate, and manage exceptions or unresolved escalation.
Engineering
Assess technically; respond/dispatch safely; coordinate access; report work status. Does not decide lease responsibility or waive charges.
Property manager
Handles permitted exception and unresolved escalation decisions; may waive only for a documented building-caused event.
Asset director
Strategic oversight of material recurring process issues through management, not ordinary ticket handling.



5. What changed and why it matters
Prior period / pain point
July 1 procedure
Practical effect
A phone report could lead to a separate portal entry for the same issue.
One primary portal route during staffed hours; a fallback caller receives/links one ticket. Add later information using the same reference.
Less duplicate entry while retaining a complete record for dispatch, updates, escalation, and closure.
“Urgent” could mean immediate danger or a same-day patient-operation problem.
Emergency = immediate threat; Urgent = non-life-safety, same-day patient-operation impact; Routine = normal scheduling.
Front-desk staff can choose a safe path quickly without changing engineering dispatch priorities.
After-hours HVAC approval could be verbal before July 1.
From July 1, written approval from an authorized tenant contact is required for tenant-requested after-hours HVAC.
The tenant knows the authorization needed before non-emergency HVAC proceeds and can avoid delay.
Tenants lacked clarity about potential charges.
Potential chargeability is flagged for lease review; available basis/estimate and required approval are communicated before non-emergency potentially billable work.
Better visibility without inventing fees or treating a request, estimate, or dispatch as a final bill.
Failure assumed a working portal, reachable contact, and available access.
Conspicuous continuation paths cover portal outage, failed access, unreachable contact, incomplete intake, and missing authorization.
Requests stay traceable and safety response is never trapped behind a failed administrative step.

Local contacts and controlled fields
Complete these editable fields locally. Do not replace them with unverified details.
Function
Local field
Primary staffed-hours portal
[SERVICE REQUEST PORTAL / URL]
Service coordination / routine escalation
[SERVICE COORDINATION CONTACT / EMAIL]
After-hours urgent or property record after emergency
[ON-CALL SERVICE NUMBER]
Written HVAC authorization delivery
[AUTHORIZATION SUBMISSION METHOD]
On-site emergency action reference
[APPLICABLE ON-SITE EMERGENCY ACTION]

Reader check
Before submitting: (1) choose Emergency, Urgent, or Routine; (2) use the matching channel; (3) give location, observations, timing, impact, contact, access, and approval status; (4) save the ticket; (5) use that ticket for every update or escalation. If the condition becomes dangerous, switch immediately to the Emergency path.

criteria.description: 所需的 DOCX 存在于顶层，文件名为 `alder_point_service_request_procedure.docx`，并作为有效的 Word 文档打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认确切的文件名、位置、扩展名，以及 DOCX 是否可以打开和检查。

original.criterion: The required DOCX exists at the top level under the exact filename `alder_point_service_request_procedure.docx` and opens as a valid Word document.
original.evidence: Submitted file and DOCX package structure.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact filename, location, extension, and that the DOCX can be opened and inspected.

criteria.description: 呈现的文档不超过六页，包括任何快速指南、变更摘要和联系字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准办公套件渲染 DOCX 并计算所有页面。

original.criterion: The rendered document is no more than six pages, including any quick guide, change summary, and contact fields.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX using a standard office suite and count all pages.

criteria.description: 该过程仍可作为本机 Word 内容进行编辑，而不是作为页面大小的图像提供。
criteria.evidence: DOCX 段落、表格、形状和文本对象。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否可以在 Word 或 LibreOffice 中选择和编辑实质性文本。

original.criterion: The procedure remains editable as native Word content rather than being delivered as page-sized images.
original.evidence: DOCX paragraphs, tables, shapes, and text objects.
original.grader_hint: Inspect whether substantive text can be selected and edited in Word or LibreOffice.

criteria.description: 该文件将自己标识为 Alder Point Medical Plaza 的租户服务请求和升级程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果过程函数和属性名称都是显式的，则接受封闭标题措辞。

original.criterion: The document identifies itself as the tenant service-request and escalation procedure for Alder Point Medical Plaza.
original.grader_hint: Accept close title wording if both the procedure function and property name are explicit.

criteria.description: 该文档显示修订或版本标识符以及生效日期或有效期声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 查看标题、页眉、页脚或修订块附近；打印程序时该信息必须可用。

original.criterion: The document displays a revision or version identifier and an effective date or effective-period statement.
original.grader_hint: Look near the title, header, footer, or revision block; the information must be usable when the procedure is printed.

criteria.description: 目标读者被确定为租户实践管理员和前台工作人员，包括不熟悉该流程的读者。
criteria.evidence: 观众陈述或介绍性语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 措辞不必逐字重复请求，但必须使操作受众清楚。

original.criterion: The intended readers are identified as tenant practice administrators and front-desk staff, including readers unfamiliar with the process.
original.grader_hint: The wording need not repeat the request verbatim but must make the operating audience clear.

criteria.description: 其目的是解释该程序管理租户服务问题的报告、跟踪、升级和关闭，而不仅仅是描述门户。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅当生命周期超出初始提交时才授予奖励。

original.criterion: The purpose explains that the procedure governs reporting, tracking, escalation, and closure of tenant service issues rather than merely describing a portal.
original.grader_hint: Award only if the lifecycle extends beyond initial submission.

criteria.description: 范围涵盖所有三座广场建筑的医师执业租户空间以及相关的常见或建筑服务问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 该程序不应被理解为仅适用于一套套房或一栋建筑。

original.criterion: The scope covers physician-practice tenant spaces and relevant common or building-service issues across all three plaza buildings.
original.grader_hint: The procedure should not read as if it applies to only one suite or one building.

criteria.description: 该文件保留了该程序不修改租赁义务、收费或工程师派遣优先级的界限。
criteria.evidence: 范围限制、计费语言和优先级语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查完整的文档是否有清晰的边界并与其保持一致。

original.criterion: The document preserves the boundary that the procedure does not modify lease obligations, chargeability, or engineer dispatch priorities.
original.evidence: Scope limitations, billing language, and priority language.
original.grader_hint: Check the complete document for a clear boundary and for consistency with it.

criteria.description: 未知的本地电话号码、电子邮件地址和门户 URL 通过明确无误的填写内容来表示，而不是捏造的详细信息。
criteria.evidence: 整个文档中的联系人和渠道字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受诸如`[ON-CALL NUMBER]`之类的标签或风格清晰的空白字段；不需要特定的占位符语法。

original.criterion: Unknown local phone numbers, email addresses, and portal URLs are represented by unmistakable fill-ins rather than fabricated details.
original.evidence: Contact and channel fields throughout the document.
original.grader_hint: Accept labels such as `[ON-CALL NUMBER]` or clearly styled blank fields; do not require a particular placeholder syntax.

criteria.description: 该程序赋予“紧急”一种明确的操作含义，而不是将其用于危险和当天的操作中断。
criteria.grader_hint: 所选择的标签可能会有所不同，但读者必须能够对这两种含义进行不同的分类。

original.criterion: The procedure gives “urgent” one unambiguous operational meaning instead of using it for both hazards and same-day operational disruption.
original.grader_hint: The chosen label may vary, but a reader must be able to classify the two meanings differently.

criteria.description: 定义的紧急类别与不同于紧急情况和常规处理的独特响应路径或时间期望相关联。
criteria.evidence: 优先级定义、决策帮助和响应说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证该类别具有可操作的结果，而不仅仅是一个术语表条目。

original.criterion: The defined urgent category is linked to a distinct response path or timing expectation that differs from both emergency and routine handling.
original.evidence: Priority definitions, decision aid, and response instructions.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the category has an operational consequence and is not merely a glossary entry.

criteria.description: 紧急或生命安全类别是针对对人员、财产或关键建筑系统的直接威胁单独定义的。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求与当日患者手术问题的明确分离。

original.criterion: An emergency or life-safety category is separately defined for immediate threats to people, property, or critical building systems.
original.grader_hint: Look for a clear separation from same-day patient-operation concerns.

criteria.description: 常规类别是针对不会造成直接危险或需要当天操作干预的问题定义的。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果含义明确，措辞可以使用同义标签。

original.criterion: A routine category is defined for issues that do not present immediate danger or require same-day operational intervention.
original.grader_hint: The wording may use a synonymous label if its meaning is clear.

criteria.description: “下班后”与大楼人员配备时间相关——周一至周五，上午7:00上午至6:00下午——而不是相对于每个诊所的时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认规定的人员配备期限和由此产生的定义。

original.criterion: “After-hours” is tied to the building staffing period—outside Monday through Friday, 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.—rather than left relative to each practice's schedule.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both the stated staffed period and the resulting definition.

criteria.description: 该文件明确禁止租户自己的开门或关门时间悄悄改变大楼视为下班后的时间。
criteria.evidence: 盘后定义或解释性说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果一个理性的读者不能将练习时间与建筑工作时间混淆，则奖励。

original.criterion: The document explicitly prevents a tenant's own opening or closing time from silently changing what the building treats as after-hours.
original.grader_hint: Award if a reasonable reader cannot confuse practice hours with building staffed hours.

criteria.description: 该文档将潜在的计费请求与已确认的费用区分开来，并避免将提交或发送视为费用到期的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找保留租赁审查和最终决定的语言。

original.criterion: The document distinguishes a potentially billable request from a confirmed charge and avoids treating submission or dispatch as proof that a charge is due.
original.grader_hint: Look for language preserving lease review and final determination.

criteria.description: 简洁的分类帮助让租户可以在紧急、紧急和常规路径之间进行选择，而无需阅读整个文档。
criteria.evidence: 决策辅助、快速参考表或同等内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断初次接触前台的读者能否快速对常见问题进行分类。

original.criterion: A concise classification aid lets a tenant choose among emergency, urgent, and routine paths without reading the entire document.
original.evidence: Decision aid, quick-reference table, or equivalent.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether a first-time front-desk reader could classify a common issue quickly.

criteria.description: 紧急情况示例包括至少一种明显的生命安全状况和一种威胁重大财产损失或关键建筑运行的状况。
criteria.grader_hint: 示例可能包括火灾或烟雾以及不受控制的泄漏或重大公用设施故障；等效的例子是可以接受的。

original.criterion: Emergency examples include at least one clear life-safety condition and one condition threatening significant property damage or critical building operation.
original.grader_hint: Examples might include fire or smoke and an uncontrolled leak or major utility failure; equivalent examples are acceptable.

criteria.description: 紧急的例子包括严重影响当天患者手术的非生命安全问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 这个例子必须证明为什么在没有直接威胁的情况下可以存在紧迫性。

original.criterion: Urgent examples include a non-life-safety issue materially affecting same-day patient operations.
original.grader_hint: The example must demonstrate why urgency can exist without an immediate threat.

criteria.description: 常规示例包括可以遵循正常安排的普通舒适、维护或管理问题。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受与医疗办公室属性一致的职业合理示例。

original.criterion: Routine examples include ordinary comfort, maintenance, or administrative issues that can follow normal scheduling.
original.grader_hint: Accept occupationally reasonable examples consistent with a medical office property.

criteria.description: 对于迫在眉睫的危险，该程序会在普通工单处理之前指导居住者寻求紧急服务或适用的现场紧急行动。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件不得将门户提交作为获得紧急帮助的先决条件。

original.criterion: For immediate danger, the procedure directs occupants to emergency services or applicable on-site emergency action before ordinary work-order processing.
original.grader_hint: The document must not make a portal submission a prerequisite to obtaining emergency help.

criteria.description: 紧急路径明确表示，当人们处于危险之中时，不要等待门户确认或常规财产响应。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的时间敏感方向，而不仅仅是紧急联系人列表。

original.criterion: The emergency path clearly says not to wait for a portal acknowledgement or routine property response when people are in danger.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit time-sensitive direction, not merely a list of emergency contacts.

criteria.description: 安全指南告诉租户不要进入不安全区域、扰乱危险状况或尝试修理建筑系统。
criteria.grader_hint: 同等简洁的禁令是可以接受的。

original.criterion: Safety guidance tells tenants not to enter unsafe areas, disturb hazardous conditions, or attempt repairs to building systems.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent concise prohibitions are acceptable.

criteria.description: 该程序为工作时间内的非紧急请求确定了一条明确的主要接收路线。
criteria.grader_hint: 本地地址或 URL 可以是占位符，但渠道的角色必须明确。

original.criterion: The procedure identifies one clear primary intake route for non-emergency requests during staffed hours.
original.grader_hint: The local address or URL may be a placeholder, but the channel's role must be clear.

criteria.description: 该程序确定了适合问题优先级的明确的下班后报告路线。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查紧急情况或紧急下班后报告是否不会推迟到下一个值班时段。

original.criterion: The procedure identifies a clear after-hours reporting route appropriate to the issue's priority.
original.grader_hint: Check that emergency or urgent after-hours reporting is not deferred until the next staffed period.

criteria.description: 针对门户不可用提供了可用的后备方案，并在必要时对危险问题和非危险问题进行不同的处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 读者必须知道下一步该做什么，而不是被告知只能稍后再试。

original.criterion: A usable fallback is provided for portal unavailability, with different treatment where necessary for hazardous versus nonhazardous issues.
original.grader_hint: A reader must know what to do next rather than being told only to try again later.

criteria.description: 该程序可防止不必要的重复报告，同时保留记录最初通过后备通道报告的问题的方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找单票或交叉引用原则来解决 Lucia 的担忧而不丢失记录。

original.criterion: The procedure prevents unnecessary duplicate reporting while preserving a way to document an issue initially reported through a fallback channel.
original.grader_hint: Look for a single-ticket or cross-reference principle that addresses Lucia's concern without losing the record.

criteria.description: 提交说明需要建筑物、练习或套件以及确切的问题位置。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有位置组件必须足以在三栋建筑的园区内进行调度。

original.criterion: Submission instructions require the building, practice or suite, and exact issue location.
original.grader_hint: All location components must be sufficient for dispatch across a three-building campus.

criteria.description: 提交指令需要请求者名称和可靠的回调方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果通用联系人字段明确支持双向通信，则可以接受。

original.criterion: Submission instructions require a requester name and a reliable callback method.
original.grader_hint: A generic contact field is acceptable if it clearly supports two-way communication.

criteria.description: 系统会提示请求者描述观察到的情况，而不是诊断技术原因。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找提示，例如正在发生的事情、地点以及可以观察到的内容。

original.criterion: The requester is prompted to describe the observed condition rather than diagnose the technical cause.
original.grader_hint: Look for prompts such as what is happening, where, and what can be observed.

criteria.description: 系统会提示请求者提供问题开始或首次发现的时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受日期/时间、持续时间或等效的计时信息。

original.criterion: The requester is prompted to provide when the issue began or was first observed.
original.grader_hint: Accept date/time, duration, or equivalent timing information.

criteria.description: 请求者会被提示描述操作影响，包括患者护理或访问效果，而不会单独使用影响来覆盖真正的安全分类。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查影响提示以及紧急情况与紧急情况的持续分离。

original.criterion: The requester is prompted to describe the operational impact, including patient-care or access effects, without using impact alone to override a genuine safety classification.
original.grader_hint: Check both the impact prompt and the continued separation of emergency from urgent.

criteria.description: 仅当有用且安全时才要求照片或支持文件。
criteria.grader_hint: 该程序不应鼓励仅仅为了拍照而接近危险。

original.criterion: Photos or supporting files are requested only when useful and safe to obtain.
original.grader_hint: The procedure should not encourage approaching a hazard merely to photograph it.

criteria.description: 该请求包含访问时间、访问限制以及是否需要陪同或提前通知。
criteria.grader_hint: 这些信息必须帮助工程人员避免对有人占用的医疗室进行失败的访问。

original.criterion: The request captures access hours, access restrictions, and whether an escort or advance notice is needed.
original.grader_hint: The information must help engineering avoid a failed visit to an occupied medical suite.

criteria.description: 该程序警告租户不要在服务请求、照片或附件中包含患者身份信息或其他不必要的敏感信息。
criteria.grader_hint: 该指南无需引用法律；它对于执业医师人员来说必须是实用的。

original.criterion: The procedure warns tenants not to include patient-identifying or other unnecessary sensitive information in a service request, photograph, or attachment.
original.grader_hint: The guidance need not cite a law; it must be practical for physician-practice staff.

criteria.description: 该请求捕获适当的租户联系人以进行访问、授权和后续操作，而不是假设提交者拥有所有权限。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果相关，请注意请求者和授权租户联系人之间的区别。

original.criterion: The request captures the appropriate tenant contact for access, authorization, and follow-up instead of assuming the submitter has every authority.
original.grader_hint: Look for a distinction between requester and authorized tenant contact where relevant.

criteria.description: 对于可能需要批准的请求，接收指南会记录授权是否已附加、待处理或不可用。
criteria.grader_hint: 明确的地位机制就足够了；不需要特定的代码。

original.criterion: For requests that may require approval, the intake guidance records whether authorization is attached, pending, or unavailable.
original.grader_hint: A clear status mechanism is sufficient; no specific code is required.

criteria.description: 该程序解释了租户成功提交后应收到的确认信息。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认可以是自动的或手动的，但必须发出成功接收的信号。

original.criterion: The procedure explains what acknowledgement the tenant should receive after a successful submission.
original.grader_hint: The acknowledgement may be automated or manual but must signal successful receipt.

criteria.description: 票证或参考标识符用于将后续更新、调用、升级和关闭连接到原始请求。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受任何明确的跟踪参考概念。

original.criterion: A ticket or reference identifier is used to connect later updates, calls, escalations, and closure to the original request.
original.grader_hint: Accept any clear tracking-reference concept.

criteria.description: 租户被告知如何传达或确认分配的优先级。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果读者能够区分他们请求的紧迫性和酒店团队接受的优先级，则奖励。

original.criterion: The tenant is told how the assigned priority will be communicated or confirmed.
original.grader_hint: Award if the reader can distinguish their requested urgency from the priority accepted by the property team.

criteria.description: 该程序设定了租户何时收到初始响应或下次更新承诺的预期，而无需发明不受支持的合同服务保证。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果与租赁担保明确区分，则接受运营目标或及时更新的语言。

original.criterion: The procedure sets an expectation for when the tenant will receive an initial response or next-update commitment without inventing an unsupported contractual service guarantee.
original.grader_hint: Accept operational targets or prompt-update language if clearly distinguished from a lease guarantee.

criteria.description: 当优先级、访问权限、授权、预计时间或工作计划发生重大变化时，预计会更新状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 该过程不需要使用这些确切的单词，但它必须识别有意义的更新触发器。

original.criterion: Status updates are expected when priority, access, authorization, estimated timing, or the work plan materially changes.
original.grader_hint: The procedure need not use these exact words, but it must identify meaningful update triggers.

criteria.description: 租户可以使用现有参考将信息添加到开放请求，而不是创建第二个不相关的请求。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查该过程是否保持可追溯性。

original.criterion: The tenant can add information to an open request using the existing reference rather than creating a second unrelated request.
original.grader_hint: Check that the process remains traceable.

criteria.description: 结束包括沟通已完成或观察到的内容以及任何剩余的租户行动、监控或后续行动。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅仅“关闭”状态是不够的。

original.criterion: Closure includes communication of what was done or observed and any remaining tenant action, monitoring, or follow-up.
original.grader_hint: A bare status of “closed” is insufficient.

criteria.description: 租户被告知如何使用现有记录报告未解决的、重复出现的或错误关闭的问题。
criteria.evidence: 重新开放或关闭后升级路径。
criteria.grader_hint: 这条路不能要求默默地重新开始。

original.criterion: The tenant is told how to report an unresolved, recurring, or incorrectly closed issue using the existing record.
original.grader_hint: The path must not require silently starting over.

criteria.description: 紧急升级路径可快速将问题与适当的紧急或待命响应联系起来，然后在安全时保存财产记录。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查顺序：安全响应第一，管理记录第二。

original.criterion: The emergency escalation path rapidly connects the issue to the appropriate emergency or on-call response and then preserves a property record when safe.
original.grader_hint: Check the sequence: safety response first, administrative recording second.

criteria.description: 该程序规定了如果紧急请求未得到确认或情况恶化，租户应该做什么。
criteria.grader_hint: 下一步行动必须具体，并且必须考虑到重新分类为紧急情况。

original.criterion: The procedure states what a tenant should do if an urgent request is not acknowledged or the condition worsens.
original.grader_hint: The next action must be concrete and must account for reclassification as an emergency.

criteria.description: 该过程说明了当错过传达的响应或更新期望时如何升级例行请求。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找实际的触发因素和下一个联系人或角色。

original.criterion: The procedure states how a routine request is escalated when the communicated response or update expectation is missed.
original.grader_hint: Look for a practical trigger and next contact or role.

criteria.description: 升级阶梯根据运营角色和问题状态来识别联系人，而不是将每个问题直接发送给资产总监。
criteria.grader_hint: 合理的阶梯通常根据情况通过服务协调、工程或物业管理。

original.criterion: The escalation ladder identifies contacts by operational role and issue state rather than sending every concern directly to the asset director.
original.grader_hint: A sensible ladder ordinarily moves through service coordination, engineering or property management as appropriate.

criteria.description: 如果没有替代操作，升级不会将租户送回同一个不可用通道。
criteria.grader_hint: 走遍每条故障路径并验证它是前进而不是循环。

original.criterion: Escalation does not send the tenant back to the same unavailable channel without an alternative action.
original.grader_hint: Walk each failure path and verify that it advances rather than loops.

criteria.description: 指示租户保留票号并记录失败的联系尝试或升级时的重大更改。
criteria.grader_hint: 等效的简明文档指南是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The tenant is instructed to preserve the ticket number and record failed contact attempts or significant changes when escalating.
original.grader_hint: Equivalent concise documentation guidance is acceptable.

criteria.description: 当工程人员无法按计划进入套房或限制区域时，该程序提供了一条路径。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找通知、重新安排或替代访问协调以及开放请求的保存。

original.criterion: The procedure provides a path when engineering cannot enter the suite or restricted area as planned.
original.grader_hint: Look for notification, rescheduling or alternate access coordination, and preservation of the open request.

criteria.description: 当无法联系到请求者或租户联系人进行澄清时，该程序提供了一条途径。
criteria.grader_hint: 该路径应区分安全延迟和需要保护操作的情况。

original.criterion: The procedure provides a path when the requester or tenant contact cannot be reached for clarification.
original.grader_hint: The path should distinguish safe deferral from conditions requiring protective action.

criteria.description: 当无法获得所需的书面授权时，该程序提供了一条途径。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查该程序是否假定获得批准、伪造同意或只是在没有状态的情况下放弃该问题。

original.criterion: The procedure provides a path when required written authorization cannot be obtained.
original.grader_hint: Check that the procedure does not assume approval, fabricate consent, or simply abandon the issue without status.

criteria.description: 当提交者不知道谁有权批准可能的计费服务时，该过程提供了一条路径。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果责任明确，则可以接受物业团队验证路径或租户方推荐。

original.criterion: The procedure provides a path when the submitter does not know who is authorized to approve a potentially billable service.
original.grader_hint: A property-team verification path or tenant-side referral is acceptable if responsibility is clear.

criteria.description: 不完整的请求会被确认并路由以进行澄清，而不是默默地拒绝或根据不受支持的假设进行发送。
criteria.grader_hint: 安全关键情况可能仍需要立即采取保护措施；文件应允许这种区分。

original.criterion: An incomplete request is acknowledged and routed for clarification rather than silently rejected or dispatched on unsupported assumptions.
original.grader_hint: Safety-critical conditions may still require immediate protective action; the document should allow that distinction.

criteria.description: 下班后 HVAC 部分规定，7 月 1 之前的请求可以口头批准，7 月 1 以后的请求需要获得授权租户联系人的书面批准。
criteria.evidence: 政策过渡和 HVAC 授权说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 两个期限、边界日期、更改的批准表格和授权联系条件必须一致。

original.criterion: The after-hours HVAC section states that requests before July 1 could use verbal approval and that requests from July 1 onward require written approval from an authorized tenant contact.
original.evidence: Policy transition and HVAC authorization instructions.
original.grader_hint: Both periods, the boundary date, the changed approval form, and the authorized-contact condition must agree.

criteria.description: 提供了上一时期和新时期的 HVAC 审批规则，以便读者无需从文档历史记录中推断出适用哪条规则。
criteria.evidence: 变更摘要、生效日期说明和操作说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 7 月 1 两侧发生的请求的可用性。

original.criterion: The prior-period and new-period HVAC approval rules are presented so a reader can tell which rule applies without inferring it from document history.
original.evidence: Change summary, effective-date note, and operating instructions.
original.grader_hint: Check usability for a request occurring on either side of July 1.

criteria.description: 书面 HVAC 批准与授权租户联系人相关，而不是与碰巧提交请求的任何员工相关。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文档可以使用租户维护的授权列表或等效控制。

original.criterion: Written HVAC approval is associated with an authorized tenant contact rather than any employee who happens to submit the request.
original.grader_hint: The document may use a tenant-maintained authorization list or equivalent control.

criteria.description: 在可获得成本信息的情况下，该程序要求在进行非紧急的潜在计费工作之前传达基础或估算。
criteria.grader_hint: 不要求虚报费用；使用可用信息寻求透明的沟通。

original.criterion: Where cost information is available, the procedure calls for communicating the basis or estimate before non-emergency potentially billable work proceeds.
original.grader_hint: Do not require a fabricated fee; look for transparent communication using available information.

criteria.description: 该文件指出，适用的租赁决定服务是否收费。
criteria.grader_hint: 该声明不得替代租赁程序。

original.criterion: The document states that the applicable lease determines whether a service is chargeable.
original.grader_hint: The statement must not substitute the procedure for the lease.

criteria.description: 估计、授权和服务请求不被描述为最终发票或最终金额的保证。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有计费语言，明确区分估算、授权、收费和最终计费。

original.criterion: Estimates, authorizations, and service requests are not described as final invoices or guarantees of the ultimate amount.
original.grader_hint: Review all billing language for a clear distinction among estimate, authorization, chargeability, and final billing.

criteria.description: 只有物业经理有权免除费用，并且仅限于有记录的建筑引起的事件。
criteria.grader_hint: 角色边界和资格条件都必须存在。

original.criterion: Only the property manager is assigned authority to waive a charge, and only for a documented building-caused event.
original.grader_hint: Both the role boundary and qualifying condition must be present.

criteria.description: 该程序明确规定，工程师和面向租户的工作人员不能承诺或批准计费豁免。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查其他地方是否没有任何相互矛盾的陈述赋予他们明显的权威。

original.criterion: The procedure makes clear that engineers and tenant-facing staff cannot promise or approve a billing waiver.
original.grader_hint: Check that no conflicting statement elsewhere gives them apparent authority.

criteria.description: 立即的保护或紧急行动不会仅仅因为无法获得计费授权而被延迟。
criteria.grader_hint: 该程序应将安全响应与后续责任或计费审查分开。

original.criterion: Immediate protective or emergency action is not delayed solely because billing authorization is unavailable.
original.grader_hint: The procedure should separate safety response from later responsibility or billing review.

criteria.description: 当授权仍悬而未决时，需要授权的非紧急工作具有明确的保留、澄清或计划状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 请求应该保持可追踪性，并且租户应该知道是什么阻碍了进展。

original.criterion: Non-emergency work requiring authorization has a clear hold, clarification, or scheduling status when authorization is still pending.
original.grader_hint: The request should remain traceable and the tenant should know what is blocking progress.

criteria.description: 计费部分通过告诉租户何时标记潜在的收费、需要哪些批准以及在何处确定最终责任来减少意外。
criteria.grader_hint: 将此部分视为对索尔维格担忧的面向租户的答案，而不是一组互不相关的免责声明。

original.criterion: The billing section reduces surprise by telling tenants when potential chargeability will be flagged, what approval is needed, and where final responsibility is determined.
original.grader_hint: Judge the section as a tenant-facing answer to Solveig's concern, not as a collection of disconnected disclaimers.

criteria.description: 租户的责任包括准确报告、安全访问协调、及时响应以及在适用时提供授权。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果一切都明确的话，可以通过程序分配责任。

original.criterion: Tenant responsibilities include accurate reporting, safe access coordination, timely responses, and provision of authorization when applicable.
original.grader_hint: The responsibilities may be distributed through the procedure if all are clear.

criteria.description: 前台工作人员被赋予了一个可用的角色，不需要他们诊断设备、解释租赁或承诺计费结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 第一天的工作人员应该能够在不越权的情况下报告和解决问题。

original.criterion: Front-desk staff are given a usable role that does not require them to diagnose equipment, interpret leases, or promise billing outcomes.
original.grader_hint: A day-one staff member should be able to report and route an issue without exceeding authority.

criteria.description: 物业服务或管理团队负责接收、分类、沟通、跟踪和协调。
criteria.grader_hint: 职能可以在角色之间划分，但不能无所有者。

original.criterion: The property service or management team is assigned responsibility for receipt, triage, communication, tracking, and coordination.
original.grader_hint: The functions may be split among roles but cannot be left ownerless.

criteria.description: 工程人员被分配技术评估、安全调度或响应、访问协调和工作状态输入，而无需获得租赁或弃权权限。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查责任声明和计费部分。

original.criterion: Engineering is assigned technical assessment, safe dispatch or response, access coordination, and work-status input without being given lease or waiver authority.
original.grader_hint: Review the responsibility statement together with the billing sections.

criteria.description: 物业经理在规定的政策范围内被分配例外、未解决的升级和允许的豁免决定。
criteria.grader_hint: 不应要求该角色执行每项例行摄入操作。

original.criterion: The property manager is assigned exception, unresolved escalation, and permitted waiver decisions within the stated policy boundary.
original.grader_hint: The role should not be required to perform every routine intake action.

criteria.description: 资产总监并不是日常工作订单的第一联系人，而重大的重复性流程问题可能会通过管理层提出。
criteria.evidence: 升级层次结构和治理语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果战略监督与日常票据处理分开，则奖励。

original.criterion: The asset director is not presented as the ordinary first contact for routine work orders, while material recurring process issues may be elevated through management.
original.grader_hint: Award if strategic oversight is separated from daily ticket handling.

criteria.description: 每次使用正常时间、值班时间、营业时间或非工作时间均符合规定的周一至周五7:00上午–6:00下午。建设人员配备期。
criteria.evidence: 文档中的所有时序参考。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索每个与时间相关的术语并检查是否存在矛盾或无法解释的交替时期。

original.criterion: Every use of normal hours, staffed hours, business hours, or after-hours agrees with the stated Monday-through-Friday 7:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. building staffing period.

original.criterion: The revision visibly addresses all three review concerns: duplicate phone-and-portal entry, after-hours HVAC authorization uncertainty, and surprise-billing concern.

original.evidence: Quick guide, detailed procedure, escalation section, and contact fields.
original.grader_hint: Cross-check repeated channel instructions for conflicting sequences or destinations.

criteria.description: 优先权、非工作时间、授权、收费和弃权术语在定义、说明、示例和变更摘要中保留相同的含义。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索每个关键术语并测试后面的语句是否会更改其范围或权限。

original.criterion: Priority, after-hours, authorization, chargeability, and waiver terms retain the same meanings across definitions, instructions, examples, and the change summary.
original.grader_hint: Search each key term and test whether any later statement changes its scope or authority.

criteria.description: 该文件并未将虚构的费用、租赁条款、联系方式、门户 URL 或不受支持的服务保证作为事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 区分清楚标记的填充内容和不具约束力的运营目标与捏造的当地事实。

original.criterion: The document does not present invented fees, lease clauses, contact details, portal URLs, or unsupported service guarantees as facts.
original.grader_hint: Distinguish clearly marked fill-ins and nonbinding operating targets from fabricated local facts.

criteria.description: 第一天的实践管理员或前台员工可以独立选择正确的路径，提交足够的信息，并知道会发生什么，而无需询问文档的作者。
criteria.evidence: 作为操作仪器的完整程序。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过一项紧急情况、一项当天影响患者的问题、一项常规问题和一项门户中断进行心理测试。

original.criterion: A day-one practice administrator or front-desk employee could independently choose the correct path, submit enough information, and know what to expect without asking the document's author.
original.evidence: Complete procedure as an operating instrument.
original.grader_hint: Test mentally with one emergency, one same-day patient-impacting issue, one routine issue, and one portal outage.

criteria.description: 失败路径足够明显，读者可以找到当通道、访问尝试、联系尝试或授权步骤无法完成时该怎么做。

criteria.grader_hint: 如果案例在技术上被提及但被隐藏或与相关步骤脱节，则不要奖励。

original.criterion: Failure paths are conspicuous enough that a reader can find what to do when a channel, access attempt, contact attempt, or authorization step cannot be completed.
original.evidence: Fallback and exception guidance plus rendered navigation.
original.grader_hint: Do not award if the cases are technically mentioned but buried or disconnected from the relevant steps.

criteria.description: 成品经过专业抛光、清晰、可打印，适合跨职能内部审批和租户使用。

spec.professional_context: Highmarsh Field Services manages tenant operations at Alder Point Medical Plaza for Amberfield Logistics. The procedure must reduce tenant effort without removing information, authorization, safety, and escalation controls needed by the property and engineering teams.
difficulty_sources: Converting symptom-level feedback about complexity into a tenant-usable instructional procedure without removing dispatch, access, authorization, billing, and escalation controls.
Resolving the two operational meanings of “urgent” consistently throughout a short document.
Designing explicit continuation paths for failed channels, access, contacts, and authorizations.
Comparing the prior and post-July 1 operating periods while preserving lease and authority boundaries.

authoring_plan.solver_instance: Create an editable, tenant-facing Word procedure that revises a superficially shortened draft in response to explicit stakeholder concerns. The artifact must teach a new practice administrator or front-desk employee to classify, submit, monitor, escalate, authorize, and close a service request without requiring local details that were not supplied.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: A strong solution simplifies the tenant's decisions and eliminates duplicate entry while retaining the information and controls needed for safe dispatch, access, written authorization, lease-based billing review, communication, escalation, and closure. A merely shorter document that ignores the discovered pain points or assumes every step succeeds should not pass most substantive criteria.
facts_and_policy_bounds: Highmarsh Field Services manages Alder Point Medical Plaza for Amberfield Logistics.
The plaza contains three buildings occupied by physician practices.
The building staffing period is Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.; tenant practice hours vary and do not redefine building after-hours.
Before July 1, verbal approval was accepted for tenant-requested after-hours HVAC.
From July 1 onward, written approval from an authorized tenant contact is required for tenant-requested after-hours HVAC.
The property manager may waive a charge only for a documented building-caused event.
Engineers and tenant-facing staff cannot promise or approve a waiver.
The revision may simplify intake and escalation but may not change engineer dispatch priorities, lease obligations, or the approval policy.
No fees, lease clauses, phone numbers, email addresses, portal URLs, or contractual service guarantees are available for invention.
imperfections_and_tensions_to_preserve: The asset director's instruction to simplify is only a symptom-level comment; stakeholder review reveals three different sources of friction.
One administrator objects to entering the same issue by phone and in the portal.
One administrator lacks visibility into whether after-hours HVAC will be charged.
The chief engineer needs adequate issue, location, impact, access, and contact information for safe dispatch.
Tenants use the word urgent for both immediate threats and nonhazardous same-day patient-operation impacts.
The current process assumes the portal, authorization, access, and contact attempts always succeed.
The portal is occasionally unavailable and the authorized tenant contact may be unreachable.
The procedure must compare the prior and new periods and explain the material operational effects of the changes.
gold_relationships: Emergency, urgent, and routine must be mutually understandable categories; the immediate-threat meaning cannot remain merged with the same-day operational-impact meaning.
After-hours must be derived from the stated building staffing period, not from variable tenant practice hours.
The normal route, after-hours route, emergency route, and portal-outage fallback must form a coherent set without duplicate-entry requirements or dead-end loops.
Initial emergency action must precede ordinary administrative recording when delay would endanger people or property.
Request information must be sufficient for triage and dispatch while avoiding patient-identifying information and unsafe evidence gathering.
A successful request must have acknowledgement and a tracking reference that persists through updates, escalation, and closure.
Escalation must vary with priority and must specify what happens after a missed acknowledgement, missed update, worsening condition, or failed channel.
Failure paths must keep requests traceable when access fails, contacts are unreachable, written authorization is unavailable, the billing contact is unknown, or intake information is incomplete.
The HVAC approval rule must switch at July 1 from verbal acceptance to written approval by an authorized tenant contact.
Potential chargeability, estimate or authorization, and final billing determination must remain distinct concepts.
Lease terms govern chargeability; only the property manager may waive a charge, and only for a documented building-caused event.
Safety-protective action cannot be blocked solely by absent billing authorization, while non-emergency work that requires authorization needs a visible pending or hold state.
The change comparison must identify both what changed and why it matters to tenant effort, authorization clarity, or billing visibility.
Repeated channels, times, terms, and authority statements must agree across the quick reference, detailed procedure, escalation guidance, and change summary.
expected_professional_content: Purpose, audience, scope, policy boundaries, and document-control information.
Operational definitions and a concise classification aid.
Examples suitable to medical-office property operations.
Safety-first emergency instructions and limits on tenant self-help.
Normal-hours, after-hours, and unavailable-channel intake paths.
Minimum request information covering location, observations, timing, operational impact, contact, access, privacy, and authorization status.
Acknowledgement, tracking, status-update, closure, reopening, and escalation expectations.
Exception paths for portal failure, failed access, unreachable contacts, missing authorization, unknown approver, and incomplete information.
After-hours HVAC authorization and transparent potential-charge communication.
Role boundaries for tenant staff, service coordination, engineering, property management, and asset oversight.
A prior-versus-new comparison with practical reasons and transition handling.
Editable placeholders for all unavailable local contact or system details.
authoring_plan.space_feasibility: The six-page cap can accommodate a compact quick-reference element, definitions, submission and escalation instructions, authorization and billing guidance, failure paths, roles, and a brief change comparison at normal professional document density. The rubric does not require separate pages or duplicated explanations.
authoring_plan.offline_validation: An imagined reference DOCX was walked against all rubric items using standard Word-generation and rendering tools. Every requirement can be satisfied without internet access or supplied files by combining the stated local facts with ordinary commercial property-management practice and clearly marked fill-ins.

title_original: alder point tenant service request revision
original_instruction:
You are the property manager for Highmarsh Field Services at Alder Point Medical Plaza, a three-building physician-practice campus managed for Amberfield Logistics. Ruben Tikhonov, the asset director, wants the tenant service-request process simplified before renewals begin because tenants have called it “too complicated” for months. Maren Rasmussen’s draft shortened the instructions, but review by practice administrators Lucia Carmody and Solveig Lombardi and chief engineer Bohdan Maldonado showed that they were describing different problems: Lucia objects to entering the same issue by phone and in the portal, Solveig is concerned about not knowing when after-hours HVAC will be charged, and Bohdan still needs enough information to dispatch safely and gain access. They also use “urgent” in two different ways—some mean an immediate threat to people or property, while others mean a same-day issue affecting patient operations—so the revised document cannot leave that term open to interpretation. The current procedure also assumes every submission, authorization, and contact attempt succeeds, even though the portal occasionally becomes unavailable and the authorized tenant contact may be unreachable. Rewrite the procedure for practice administrators and front-desk staff, including a day-one reader who has never used the process. The building is staffed Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.; individual practice hours vary. Before July 1, verbal approval was accepted for tenant-requested after-hours HVAC, but from July 1 onward the owner requires written approval from an authorized tenant contact. Lease terms still determine chargeability, and the property manager may waive a charge only for a documented building-caused event; neither the engineer nor tenant-facing staff may promise a waiver. You may simplify intake and escalation, but you may not alter engineer dispatch priorities, lease obligations, or that approval policy. Show tenants what changed between the prior and new periods and why it matters. Do not invent fees, lease clauses, phone numbers, email addresses, or portal URLs; use unmistakable fill-ins where local contact details are unavailable. Keep the complete procedure to no more than six pages and make it practical to print, edit, and reuse. Write the finished file into the top level of the working directory as `alder_point_service_request_procedure.docx`.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `alder_point_service_request_procedure.docx` — Revised tenant service-request and escalation procedure for Alder Point Medical Plaza tenants. (Place the file at the top level of the working directory using the exact filename.; The complete document must not exceed six pages.; It must be editable, printable, and reusable by practice administrators and front-desk staff.; It must distinguish the procedure effective before July 1 from the procedure effective July 1 onward.; It must not invent fees, lease clauses, contact details, portal URLs, or waiver authority.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
